bayts.text: We have sought gratitude (toward) Him Who by the Kāf and the Nūn ("Kun", Be) does what He wills, of the manifest and the hidden,
(namely) Allah — exalted be He —: He is the All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), All-Powerful, and He is the Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), my refuge, and He enriches me.
Through Him I have become free of (false) lords forever, and I hope from Him an unfailing reward (Qurʾān 41:8).
To Him I have already repented, having made a sale (of the soul), and He has removed me from the prohibitions and from the deeds of a madman.
I have turned my face to Him with remembrance, possessed of services to the one who brought us the obligatory and the Sunna.
I have adorned the qaṣīdas for the Bestower (Al-Wahhāb), thanking Him with them, and He drove to me what surpassed expectation.
With a Beneficent, Powerful, Kind One I am well pleased here, and He has bestowed on me from Himself a precious, treasured (gift).
I conversed with Him intimately seeking succour, and He is generous; and before He saved the one of the valley (Moses) and the one of the fish (Jonah).
O Allah, O Living (Al-Ḥayy), O Self-Subsisting (Al-Qayyūm), take me by the hand, and guard my side with a secret from You, hidden.
You are the Guardian (Al-Ḥafīẓ) Whose protection I seek: so spare me every creature that makes me suffer.
I conversed with You intimately today, O You Who have been generosity for me, O Enricher Whose bounty makes me forget my trial.
You are the Generous Who gives without cause, O Best Healer Who healed all of me with betterment.
You healed me this year: so accept that with which I thanked You, when the Nūn before the Fāʾ and the Sīn (nafs, the soul) became good.
You spared me all the enemies, O my King, O You Who protect me from disgrace and save me.
I am well pleased with You with a good pleasure that does not leave me: You have tamed for me the people of Zaqqūm and Sijjīn.
You repelled from me those deluded by their carrion (the world), who expelled me like a captive and a prisoner.
From me, singly and in pairs, they turned back, and they are deaf, dumb and blind like the devils.
You held them back from my side after their onslaught, O Owner of dominion, O Lord of the sultans.
You repel them forever from harming me, and You give me victory through them over them, and beyond the request You give me.
I wrote at sea that I do not stretch out my hand to the Christians, slaves of water and clay,
if He wills it, He through Whom I seek repose, through Him, in this world and the Next, with rectification and settlement.
To Allah — exalted be He — (belong) my hand and the heart with my body; and He drove to me what is beyond what the petty sultans have.
He tamed my enemies for me at sea, and they bound themselves to me; and all, in what has passed, used to give me (what I asked).
My turning is toward Him to Whom, whenever I complain, He removes the complaint, and has led to me what I love by bringing it into being.
He leads to me all that I love without cause — how generous He is! — and with the best gratitude He gives me life.
He gave me refuge and protected me from my enemies together, and from a rebellious, accursed one (Satan) who almost led me astray.
What an excellent Guardian, He Whose protection whenever I sought, He protected me and spared me my adversary by softening him!
From me He dispelled darknesses that held me back, and with guidance He bestowed on me, truly, with clarity.
He effaced my faults that used to shake me, and for me He appoints good with every appointing.
My heart has turned with gratitude toward Him, with the service of the Chosen; and longing scorches me.
He has blessed him with peace, with all his (Family), and bestowed on me from Himself an honour with a stored (treasure).
Grant me, by Your being the Bestower, my wishes together, O Best Giver, with the giving of treasuries.
O Allah, O Kind (Al-Barr), O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), drive my aim to me as long as I live, without earning, not saddened.
O Best, Kind, Merciful One, grant this servant of Yours that he not be reckoned with on the day of the scales.
Turn generosity toward my mother and my father, and reward them on my behalf with good, with honour.
Bless the Prophet with peace, with the ḥanīfs, O You Who spared me an enemy who almost disgraced me.
To You be praise, good pleasure and gratitude forever, O Best Lord, Nurturer Who makes me ascend.
I complain to You of what is hidden in the heart: complete my wish with mastery and instruction.
Turn toward me what I hope for without burdens, and hold back from me the wicked who meet me.
You are the All-Powerful (Al-Qadīr) Whom nothing can render powerless: so tame with Your might for me all the magnates (dahāqīn).
Tame for me with Your might those who made the Eternal Refuge (Aṣ-Ṣamad) a trinity, deaf, dumb and blind like madmen.
I have called upon You today, O Subduer (Al-Qahhār), O my King, O You for Whom my gratitude and love consume me.
O Best Enricher, Rich, Who has no partner in dominion and praise, Who saves me and enriches me.
O Owner of dominion, O You Who are exalted above having a child, tame for me all the people of Easter and Palm Sunday (the Christians).
Turn toward me today secrets that stay with me, and spare me everything that may afflict me.
Answer my supplication with what has surpassed expectations, here, O Enricher Whose bounty brings a precious (gift).
